info.name: knowledge_graph
info.description:
Knowledge graph API on port 8001.

**UI wizard (folder 0) — all API, no file copy:**
1. Health + inspect (ontologies / sources / graphs / checklist)
2. POST ontology → GET ontology
3. PUT mapping → POST db connection → GET db inspect → POST source → POST graph
4. Checklist ready → POST build → poll job + build/status
5. Metadata / query / brain

Guide: `knowledge_graph/UI_CONTROL_PLAN.md` · `knowledge_graph/POSTMAN.md`.

Auth: Bearer `{{apiToken}}` only if set. Always `X-Clearance: {{clearance}}` (internal).

item.name: 0 UI wizard (empty → live)
item.description: Full UI-control path. Inspect first, then register ontology/mapping/DB/source/graph, then build and poll status. No manual file copies. Postgres password stays in .env.

request.description:
Evidence pack used by Fashion Brain.

**Input (BrainRetrieveRequest)**
- `question` string
- `intent` e.g. `product_count` | `specification` | `news` | `products` | `shared_products`
- `filters` object of catalog fields
- `group_by` string or null
- `analysis` bool — type-wise top tables/charts
- `suggest` bool — product specification sheet
- `limit`, `season_name`, `upcoming`, `corrections`

**Output (BrainRetrieveResponse)**
- `text`, `evidence[]`, `caveats[]`, `unavailable[]`, `synthetic_data`, `routes_hint[]`
